summary: Hanji 827 adds an early Taixue work-and-education branch: Mingjing recommendation, official-family entry, study, examination, and office placement make classical learning an appointment pipeline before later student-petition and Hongdu-channel competition. The same source keeps role exposure visible as Li Gu, Hu Guang, and Du Qiao's succession judgment becomes dangerous under Liang Ji and Cao Teng. Hanji 830 adds a premodern role-risk branch: students, petitioners, legal defenders, and retainers accept danger around Li Gu and Du Qiao, so social roles preserve reputation even when office power controls punishment and bodies. Hanji 847 adds a relationship-selection branch: partner, friend, boss, social-circle, and environment choices shape exposure and access, while the late-Han household and palace channel shows relational selection can protect, expose, or coerce rather than guarantee control. Hanji 853 adds a source-scoped late-Han role-and-safety case: concealed kinship, student loyalty, favorite-power complaint channels, and family retaliation show household survival, shelter, and local office depending on political exposure as much as personal capacity. Hanji 862 adds a late-Han reputation, selection, and teaching branch: talent, public name, friendship, official judgment, and local education become useful only when checked against conduct, evidence, and repair. The Huberman Lab Q&A adds a bounded formation branch: passion, originality, and memory practice are treated as engagement, apprenticeship, self-testing, and correction rather than passive introspection. Work, education, and society material emphasizes implementation over capability claims: AI, software, creative production, physical products, research, creator work, finance, public building, and institutional roles all depend on workflow ownership, distribution, verification, trust, supply chains, labor constraints, and human judgment. The AI-era education branch now combines major-choice uncertainty, teenage AI research access, AI tutoring, historical fieldwork, oral history, source judgment, and shortcut risk; durable formation comes from foundations, real-world contact, upstream questions, review, and human grounding. Workplace material covers internships, upward management, transfers, task pacing with AI, finance and banking boundaries, cabin service, communication precision, creator monetization, lifestyle cost discipline, cohort scarring in Japan, and VOL.214's bullying branch, where school violence analogies, parent-teacher pressure, asymmetrical power, self-worth separation, evidence preservation, and institutional complaint channels define the boundary problem.
